title: What If You Lived on Proxima b? Its Year Lasts 11 Days

scenes.text: What if you moved to the nearest exoplanet? Its whole year lasts just eleven days.
Proxima b circles its star every 11.2 days, from only 4.6 million miles away. That is far closer than Mercury is to our Sun.
The star is a dim red dwarf, so the planet is not instantly scorched. But it is probably locked, one side always facing the star.
scenes.keywords: planet half night half day space

scenes.text: In 2017, that star unleashed a flare that made it a thousand times brighter in just ten seconds.
That flare was ten times brighter than anything our Sun has ever blasted out, and Proxima b sits right in its path.
Nobody knows yet whether the planet kept any air. The nearest possible second Earth is 4.2 light-years away, and its sky may be on fire.
